outcome.technical: ONE mechanism, built on the affected-test derivation's own reading. plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/_manifest_phases.py: new pure gate_reach_gaps(asked, runs, answers) - [(path, why)] for each declared path no suite the gate runs reaches; reached = the gate runs it, its selection is settled by a declared unscoped call, or a selected suite is one the gate runs; a path with no answer is named 'not asked', never counted reached. plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/audit-task.py: new section 'which of a task's files its gate reaches' - _gate_reach(project, manifest, phase, task) asks _affected_tests.select for each declared file alone over the observations run-test-gate.py gathers (recorded listings + version check, the tree's suites, every Python source; _reach_facts mirrors run-test-gate._affected_facts), _affected_tests.steps_for for the unscoped-call settlement, _affected_tests.gate_runs for what the gate runs, then gate_reach_gaps.
